name: Linear text leaf settling

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Linear text leaf settling

Mechanism: `settle_text_leaves` (fast/layout.rs) tested every carried text leaf against the growing settle list with a linear scan (O(n^2) in the leaves requested per frame, 2,800 in scroll-div-cards). Track the settled ids in a set. Allowed: that function. Forbidden: any change to what is settled or measured.
measurementPlanMarkdown: bm.sh e04 over scroll-div-cards, hover-grid, tree-toggle, table-stream, dashboard-one-panel, text-log-stream, 3 reps. Pass: scroll-div-cards and hover-grid CPU down at least 3%, no scenario worse than noise, layout and text tests green.

measurements.metric: scroll-div-cards on CPU / draw p50 ms
hover-grid on CPU / draw p50 ms

reportMarkdown:
## Linear text leaf settling Finished

Passed: true. The layer of carried text leaves made the settle pass quadratic; with a set the pass is linear. Scenarios with thousands of carried leaves gain 5%; allocations and memory are unchanged. `fast::tests::layout` (9) and `fast::tests::text` (12) pass. Behaviour is identical, so no new test group.

Attempt Count: 1. Out-of-scope changes: none.
